svg.title: Taha Göktuğ Karaca — TK
svg.desc: Mobile, web, AI and quantum optimization. React Native, Expo, Flutter, React, Next.js, Java, Spring Boot, Python, Docker. A shaded brown cockroach carries code across the entire profile, text and cards, and gets shocked by TK. Four varied edge entrances, curved diagonal paths and brief pauses.

g.text: I'm Taha Göktuğ Karaca. I build products across mobile,
web and intelligent systems. I care about every part of the
experience: how it looks, how it works and how it performs.

text.tspan: — Apps built with React Native, Expo and Flutter.
— Computer vision and data-driven decision support.

g.text: BUILD WITH INTENT. SHIP WITH CARE.
